replies.author: AtditC
replies.body:
A good idea, but it can be abused very much. If you mean <iframe>, then people could just post any website, even pornsites here, and it would get out of control. <iframe> shouldn't be used. A good coder could code an <iframe> to grab your ip. ex. you click on a thread, and somebody posted an <iframe> which is actually a website which will get your ip through php etc..

But Kylo already knows what <iframe> will do so don't do that.

-1
